decisions.reason: The modular plant concept reports a strong quantified customer saving of over 600,000 euros per year, which meets aspirations, and the growing firm has the slack to carry it.
The slow-speed shredder sits close to the core offer and has its own dedicated page, which signals satisfactory standing, so there is no shortfall to trigger search for alternatives.
As a multi-model flagship line central to the firm's strategic direction, and backed by a firm that is hiring and investing, it will be carried even while its results are still uncertain.
The trommel screen is a low-risk extension of the established mobile range, and with industry turnover growing and slack available there is no performance pressure to drop it.
